# B&B Constro HVAC Solutions Pune - Complete Documentation & Context

> Comprehensive guide and machine-readable context for B&B Constro Private Limited, the premier commercial HVAC engineering and contracting company based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

## Company Overview

- **Legal Entity**: B&B Constro Private Limited
- **Founded**: Established by Mr. Pravin Bakshi (Production Engineer with extensive tenures at Hitachi, Voltas, and Daikin)
- **Experience**: 17+ years of hands-on thermodynamic and mechanical HVAC engineering
- **Certified Workforce**: 75+ certified field engineers and mobile dispatch units across Pune & PCMC
- **Projects Delivered**: 250+ commercial, industrial, healthcare, and hospitality installations across India
- **Headquarters**: Gala no 2, Behind Ramdev Baba Garage, VIIT Sq., Upper Indira Nagar, Kondhwa Budruk, Pune, Maharashtra 411037, India
- **Emergency Hotline (24/7)**: +91 91759 74749 / +91 772000 7392
- **Email**: connect@bbconstro.com
- **Website**: https://bbconstro.com

## Engineering Capabilities & Offerings

### 1. Commercial VRV / VRF Systems
- [Learn more about VRV/VRF](https://bbconstro.com/services)
- Engineered for commercial high-rises, IT parks, hospitality resorts, and enterprise headquarters.
- Advanced multi-split inverter technology with independent zone temperature control.
- Braze-free Lokring mechanical joint technology eliminating open-flame fire risks in live buildings.
- Energy modeling with seasonal COP optimization, reducing power draw by up to 25%.

### 2. Central Chiller Plants & Heavy Rigging
- [Learn more about Central Chillers](https://bbconstro.com/services)
- High-tonnage water-cooled centrifugal and air-cooled screw chiller installations.
- Primary-secondary variable speed chilled water pumping and dynamic hydraulic balancing.
- Induced draft cooling tower integration, automated chemical water treatment, and heat recovery.

### 3. Cleanroom Air Handling Units (AHU) & Contamination Control
- [Learn more about Cleanroom AHUs](https://bbconstro.com/services)
- Compliance with ISO 14644-1 (ISO Class 5 through Class 8 / US FED STD 209E Class 100 to 100,000).
- Multi-tier filtration: G4 pre-filters, F8/F9 fine bag filters, and 99.99% terminal HEPA filters.
- Tight relative humidity control (±5% RH) and continuous differential pressure cascades.

### 4. 24/7 Emergency Breakdown Response SLA
- [Book Emergency Service](https://bbconstro.com/services)
- Guaranteed 60 to 90-minute on-site arrival window across Pune and PCMC municipal belts.
- Immediate response for chiller halts, compressor burnout, refrigerant leaks, and electrical trip faults.
- Stocked mobile emergency inventory of genuine Daikin, Copeland, Danfoss, and Carrier spare parts.

### 5. Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
- [Explore AMC Plans](https://bbconstro.com/amc)
- 3 scheduled preventive visits per year (2 Dry cleaning + 1 Wet high-pressure chemical coil wash).
- Comprehensive (parts + labor + compressor), Semi-Comprehensive, and Labour AMC frameworks.
- Documented power bill reductions of 15% to 20% through preventive thermal heat-transfer restoration.

## Proven Commercial Portfolio

- [View All Project Case Studies](https://bbconstro.com/projects)
- **Magarpatta City SEZ Cybercity Towers**: 3,40,000 sq. ft. Daikin VRV installation and continuous AMC delivering 19% documented power savings.
- **Vulcan Technologies Pvt Ltd**: 85,000 sq. ft. cleanroom precision HVAC using Lokring flame-free cold joints in Pirangut.
- **Solitaire Business Hub**: 550 TR central water-cooled screw chillers with automated building management systems.
- **Dr. Pratibha Patil Hospital**: Positive-pressure laminar airflow operation theaters and critical 24/7 emergency support.
- **Orbett Hotels & Banquets**: High-capacity rapid dynamic cooling retrofits for banquet halls.
